messages:
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] 1735009999 - GPU node join failures in us-west-3 — ~32% of new nodes failing with keystore egress denied
emma: saw the alert, digging. Are these new ASG/warm-pool launches or a rolling deploy?
raj: new warm-pool joins from warmpool-asg-3. quick log snippet: 
```
2026-03-21T14:03:12Z node-7f join failed: keystore handshake failed: connection reset by peer
...
caused by: tls: remote error: handshake failure
```
maria: I merged a tighter egress ACL for audit-shipper at ~13:55 UTC that limited outbound to S3/SIEM IP sets — sounds like it may have removed the keystore CIDR group unintentionally.
jordan: confirm — I pushed the ACL change (PR #4521) to tighten egress for compliance. It removed the old managed CIDR-group `keystore-ips`.
emma: ok, we need immediate mitigation. Options: rollback the ACL, add explicit allow for keystore, or flip nodes to use NAT fallback. Rollback is fastest but needs security signoff.
maria: I can open an emergency rollback scoped to us-west-3 for 30 minutes only. That should restore joins fast. Compliance will want an audit entry.
raj: note: even if we add an SG egress, hosts using private routing might still hit the blocked path. We should target the firewall ACLs at the edge (where change landed).
ops-bot: Change request created: CR-EGR-789. Emergency rollback requested by @maria — approvals pending from @security.
emma: @security — this is causing capacity to fall and may breach SLOs if we wait. Need explicit emergency allow.
maria: security acknowledged in thread — emergency rollback approved under emergency change policy (XFER-39). Proceeding.
jordan: rolling rollback applied at 14:25 UTC for the us-west-3 egress ACL. As a precaution I also applied a temporary SG egress allow to the nodes group: 
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0a1b2c3d \
  --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 203.0.113.0/24
```
(replace CIDR with keystore service ASN block)
raj: just saw join spikes — warm-pool nodes are rejoining. join rate back to baseline within ~5m. GPU capacity stabilizing. :white_check_mark: 
emma: thanks. quick cost note: if we'd opted NAT fallback across the AZs for warm-pool we estimate ~"$1.8k/day per region" for continuous NAT egress at this scale. Rolling rollback + small SG change much cheaper.
maria: filing follow-up actions: 1) add keystore CIDR group to our infra tests, 2) add ACL change checklist item, 3) postmortem. @emma can you own the postmortem write-up?
emma: I will. Incident tagged incident-20260321-keystore-egress.
ops-bot: incident created: incident-20260321-keystore-egress. Summary: emergency rollback of egress ACL restored GPU join path. Next: postmortem + infra test + compliance audit entry. :thumbsup:
